name: Eda Ichio
source:
Ichio is the protagonist of the game. He is [url=/c17969]Ayano-neesan[/url]'s childhood friend, a third year who has been his friend since kindergarten.

Ichio is a second-year student, with a very good head and a bad reputation, he is in the same class as [url=/c64268]Seiji[/url], one of his only friends. Why does Ichio have such a bad reputation? 

Well, one day during a cleaning chore, Ichio spilled the solvent filled bucket on him. Soaked, Ichio decided to take off his clothes and change them with dry clothes. Except that Ichio took off his soaked clothes in the hallway and his dry clothes were in his classroom, locked. To make matters worse, it was at this point that a young member of the disciplinary committee, [url=/c17970]Eri[/url], found him in his underpants in the hallway. Panicked, Eri ran away screaming: "The Naked Pervert Exhibitionist Man" while Ichio was running after her, telling that it was a misunderstanding. 

It is with this sad reputation that one day Ichio is called by [url=/c64267]Tomoko-senpai[/url] to the office of the new president of the student council, [url=/c17967]Chiharu[/url], to help her with [url=/c17968]Yumi[/url], their classmate, to prepare (as a volunteer) the Christmas party for the students...

He is a great food lover, especially of ramen, a passion he shares with Ayano-neesan. He'd eat tons of it if his money would allow him to.
